person.name: Alex Park
person.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
person.summary: Full-stack software engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web applications. Specialized in React, Node.js, and cloud architecture. Passionate about clean code, test-driven development, and mentoring. Active open-source contributor with 1000+ GitHub contributions in the last year. Regular tech blogger sharing insights about software architecture and development best practices.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer

Reduced API response times by 40% through caching optimization and query tuning
highlights.extended: Mentored 4 junior developers and established team code review practices
